_notes: Prefer deploying the prebuilt image ghcr.io/jiwoochris/artex-global:latest via the Railway dashboard (New > Deploy from Docker image) instead of building the Dockerfile, which expects a precompiled binary at dist/<arch>/artex.
Set the service's public target port to 8787 under Settings > Networking.
Bind the traffic proxy to 127.0.0.1:8788 so it is never publicly routable.
See deploy/README.md for the full variable list.
